hypothesis: On the registered size-3 EML pair, greedy frozen-leaf rewrite from every size-3 start recovers the fat zero target from more non-exact starts than the thin singleton. Equal extra-basin counts reject Φ-predicts-frozen-leaf-search at this bound.

controls.description: Unweighted exact hits must stay 2 vs 1. That is the Gibbs control, not the headline.
Ranking uses n_extra_basins. Ranking on total basins would fake phi_holds whenever extras are 0 vs 0.
Every labeled size-3 tree is a start, not only the known matching formulas.
Leaves stay 1 or x. The process cannot retune constants.
The process is greedy rewrite, not GD and not a Gibbs draw from the census.

gates.criterion: Exact unweighted hits are 2 for zero and 1 for thin.
The run discloses that leaves stay 1 or x.
The run discloses that recovery is not GD and not a Gibbs sampler.
The ranking is recorded from extra basins, not from exact 2-vs-1.
The run does not claim the neural bootstrap.
